blocks.text: A genetically modified organism (GMO) is a plant, animal or microbe whose genome has been changed. Transgenic organisms are a particular group of GMOs that have received DNA from a different, unrelated species.
About 90% of the canola, cotton, corn, soybean and sugar beet grown in the world is transgenic.
